scope: Website copy for the features public v1.32.0 shipped (October 13, 2026): the Arc Spaces import in Bring Your Tabs, the German, Spanish, French and Portuguese (Brazil) interfaces, and the /space command. Every evidence path is at the immutable publicRelease tag. Retired wording is recorded as supersededClaims in docs/website-revamp-claims-v1.27.json, and changes to retained feature pages as reviewedCopyUpdates there.

arcImport.qualification: Public desktop v1.32.0. User-initiated in Bring Your Tabs (/bring-tabs); Blanc reads Arc’s StorableSidebar.json on the device only after the person chooses Arc, and never changes it. Each selected Space brings its pinned tabs, Today tabs, and folders as tab groups. With an active Patron membership each becomes a Blanc space (created, not opened); without it each opens in its own window and only the selected tab loads. Arc’s top-row Favorites can be added to a Favorites folder named Arc. Sign-ins, passwords, history, archived tabs, Notes and Easels are not imported. Arc never shipped on Linux, where the person chooses a copied StorableSidebar.json. Real-sidebar evidence covers Apple Silicon, Windows on Arm64 and GNOME on Wayland, not Intel Macs or x64 Windows, so do not claim hands-on verification there. Not account sync, a live Arc connection, or an import of logins or history.

interfaceLanguages.qualification: Public desktop v1.32.0. Blanc’s own interface is selectable in English, German, Spanish, French and Portuguese (Brazil); the translations are machine-made, so never call them human, professional or native-speaker translations, and name no other language. Blanc follows a matching system language (any Portuguese system gets pt-BR); Settings → General → Language chooses English or another language, applied after a relaunch. Web pages are not translated, and websites keep receiving the operating system’s Accept-Language (@F44-5).

spaceCommand.qualification: Public desktop v1.32.0 ships /space with the hint “Switch to a space, or type a new name to save this window”; /workspace remains a working alias. Creating and saving spaces still needs an active Patron membership, and spaces stay device-local and profile-scoped.

workspaces.qualification: Active Patrons can save the current window or create a blank space; a bound space saves its tabs and groups as the person browses. Device-local and profile-scoped; not automatic task detection.

importing.qualification: Imports bookmarks into Favorites on-device, not passwords, cookies or whole sessions. Browser detection depends on available installed profiles. Arc’s top-row Favorites come through the Arc import instead.

foundations.qualification: Public desktop v1.32.0. Blanc is a free Chromium-based browser for macOS, Windows and Linux. It installs no Chrome Web Store extensions (optional uBlock Origin is a managed blocker, not an extension runtime), ships no AI assistant, and never organizes tabs by meaning; Named Groups and Blanc Spaces are user-directed.
